descriere: Sets the configuration for the thermal motor model.
This parameter is preset as a function of the current controller sampling time (p0115[0]) and normally does not have to be changed.

Freely assignable name for a drive object. In the commissioning software, this name cannot be entered using the expert list, but is specified in the configura- tion assistant. The object name can be subsequently modified in the Project Navigator using standard Windows resources.
Sets the current for the pole position identification routine. For a two-stage technique, the current is set for the second phase.

Sets the threshold value of the frequency difference to activate the closed-loop phase control for line-drive synchro- nization. The closed-loop phase control is activated (r3819.6 = 1), if the frequency difference is less that the threshold value.

descriere_scurta: Gx_XIST1 Coarse position safe most significant bit (identified)
descriere: Sets the bit number for the safe most significant bit (MSB) of the Gx_XIST1 coarse position.
Sets the input terminal to connect probe 2.

The parameter is used to select a bearing type. 0 = No selection 1 = Manual entry 101 = STANDARD 102 = PERFORMANCE 103 = HIGH PERFORMANCE 104 = ADVANCED LIFETIME If the bearing type changes the bearing code number (p0531) is pre-assigned accordingly.
Sets the number of parameters in the inhibit list p0571 that should be withdrawn from the automatic motor and closed-loop control parameter calculation (refer to p0340, p0578), starting from index 0.

Overloading the load duty cycles applies under the prerequisite that before and after the overload, the drive con- verter is operated with its base load current - in this case, a load duty cycle of 300 s is used as basis. For booksize drive units, the following applies: Only the setting p0205 = 0 can be selected. In this particular case, the base load current has a load duty cycle of 150 % for 60 s and 176 % for 30 s. For chassis units, the following applies: The base load current for a slight overload condition is based on a load duty cycle 110 % for 60 s and 150 % for 10 s. The base load current for a high overload condition is based on a load duty cycle 150 % for 60 s and 160 % for 10 s.

descriere_scurta: is automatically set to 0 and p0009 is automatically set to 1 after this has been carried out.
descriere: Saves all parameters of the drive system to the non-volatile memory.

descriere_scurta: Speed at the start of DC braking
descriere: Sets the starting speed for DC braking. If the actual speed falls below this threshold, then DC braking is activated.
Sets the signal source for the voltage setpoint for V/f control with an independent voltage setpoint (p1300 = 19).
Displays the effective flux setpoint. The value is referred to the rated motor flux.

Displays the trigger characteristic of the pole position identification routine. The values for the characteristic of the last pole position identification routine are output every 1 ms in order to record signals (e.g. trace). The values for trigger characteristic and saturation characteristic are always output in synchronism from a time per- spective.
Sets the second signal source to acknowledge faults.

descriere_scurta: Sets the message number for message type.
descriere: Selects faults or alarms for which the message type should be changed.
Selects the units for the parameters of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller lower limit actual value
descriere: Lower limit for the actual value signal of the technology controller.
Sets the number of Drive Data Sets (DDS).
Sets the sensor type of the third temperature sensor for the motor temperature monitoring.

descriere_scurta: Analog sensor channel B voltage at actual value zero
descriere: Sets the voltage when the connected sensor is at actual value zero. At this voltage channel B supplies an actual value of zero.

Displays the error register for CANopen. Bit 0: Generic error 0 signal: No error present. 1 signal: Generic error present. Bit 1 ... 3: Not supported (always a 0 signal) Bit 4: Communications error 0 signal: There is no message in the range 8700 ... 8799. 1 signal: There is at least one message (fault or alarm) in the range 8700 ... 8799. Bit 5 ... 6: Not supported (always a 0 signal) Bit 7:; Fault outside the range 8700 ... 8799 0 signal: There is no fault outside the range 8700 ... 8799. 1 signal: There is at least one fault outside the range 8700 ... 8799.

Sets the communication parameters for CANopen Transmit Process Data Object 7 (TPDO 7). Index: [0] = PDO COB-ID [1] = PDO transmission type [2] = Inhibit time (in 100 µs) [3] = Reserved [4] = Event timer (in ms)

descriere_scurta: SI message time removed in days
descriere: Displays the relative system runtime in days when the safety message was removed.

descriere_scurta: SI time stamps to check changes (Control Unit)
descriere: Displays the time stamps for the checksums for tracking changes for Safety Integrated. The time stamps for the checksums for tracking changes (fingerprint for the "safety logbook" functionality) made to safety parameters are saved in parameters p9781[0] and p9781[1]. Index: [0] = SI time stamp for checksum to track functional changes [1] = SI time stamp for checksum to track hardware-specific changes
Sets the integral time for the I_max frequency controller.
Sets the grid division for a linear encoder.
Binector output for bit-serial interconnection of a PZD word received from the fieldbus master. The PZD is selected via p2099[1].
Displays missing enable signals that are preventing the closed-loop drive control from being commissioned.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion control signals integrated in the drive
descriere: Control signals for safety-relevant motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive.
Displays the direct-axis voltage setpoint Ud. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045
Sets the value for fixed value 2 of the technology controller.
Displays the current controller status word.

Displays the scaling of the signal to be output. A change in the output voltage by 1 volt corresponds to the value in this parameter. The units are determined by the interconnected test signal. Index: [0] = T0 [1] = T1 [2] = T2

Sets the device target topology in coded form (refer to r0098). The setting is made during commissioning. Deactivated or non-available components are also counted Index: [0] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X100 [1] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X101 [2] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X102 [3] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X103 [4] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X104 [5] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X105

Sets the reference quantity for currents. All currents specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity in this parameter corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex or 4000 0000 hex.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion enable safety functions (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the enable signals for the safe motion monitoring.
Sets the sensor to monitor the motor temperature.

Sets the motor and load revolutions for the gearbox factor of the encoder evaluation. The gearbox factor specifies the ratio between the encoder shaft and motor shaft (for motor encoders) or between the encoder shaft and the load.
Sets the rated motor current (rating plate).

descriere_scurta: Speed controller integral time adaptation speed lower
descriere: Sets the integration time of the speed controller before the adaptation speed range (0 ... p1464). This value corre- sponds to the basic setting of the integral time of the speed controller without adaptation (p1461 = 100 %).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion enable safety functions (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the enable signals for the safe motion monitoring.
Displays the position difference before the measuring gear between powering down and powering up.
Sets the number of Command Data Sets (CDS).
Operating display for the Control Unit (CU).
Sets the access level for reading and writing parameters via the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).
Sets the display filter for parameters with the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).
Sets the mode of the operating display for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP) in the operating states "ready for opera- tion" and "operation".

Sets the delay time until the background lighting of the Basic Operator Panel (BOP) is switched off. If no keys are actuated, then the background lighting automatically switches itself off after this time has expired.
Sets the required drive object that is active at the Basic Operator Panel (BOP) after booting.
Sets the device and basic drive commissioning. By appropriately setting this parameter, those parameters are filtered that can be written into in the various commis- sioning steps.

Sets the parameter filter for commissioning a Terminal Board 30 (TB30). Setting this parameter filters out the parameters that can be written into in the various commissioning steps. For the BOP, this setting also causes the read access operations to be filtered.
Exits quick commissioning (p0010 = 1) with automatic calculation of all parameters of all existing drive data sets that depend on the entries made during quick commissioning.

The parameter is used to initiate the reset of the parameters on the ENCODER drive object. Parameter p0141 is not reset. It is only reset if the entire drive unit is reset to the factory settings (p0976).
Acknowledges the password for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).
Displays the macro file saved in the appropriate directory on the memory card/device memory.
Runs the corresponding macro files. The selected macro file must be available on the memory card/device memory.

Sets the required parameters to read and write via the Basic Operator Panel (BOP). Activation: 1. p0003 = 3 (expert). 2. p0013[0...49] = requested parameter number 3. If required, enter p0011 = password in order to prevent non-authorized deactivation. 4. p0016 = 1 --> activates the selected user-defined list. Deactivation/change: 1. p0003 = 3 (expert). 2. If required, p0012 = p0011, in order to be authorized to change or deactivate the list. 3. If required p0013[0...49] = required parameter number. 4. p0016 = 1 --> activates the modified user-defined list. 5. p0003 = 0 --> deactivates the user-defined list.
Displays the firmware version of the Control Unit.
Displays the currently smoothed speed setpoint at the input of the speed controller or V/f characteristic (after the interpolator).
Displays the actual speed of the closed-loop speed control and the V/f control. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045 [2] = Calculated from f_set - f_slip
Displays the smoothed actual value of the motor speed.

Sets the reference quantity for speed and frequency. All speeds or frequencies specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity in this parameter corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex or 4000 0000 hex. The following applies: Reference frequency (in Hz) = reference speed (in (rpm) / 60)
Displays the actual power unit output voltage (Motor Module).
Displays the smoothed actual value of the DC link voltage.

Sets the reference quantity for voltages. All voltages specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. This also applies for direct voltage val- ues (= rms value) like the DC-link voltage. The reference quantity in this parameter corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex or 4000 0000 hex.
Displays actual absolute current. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045
Displays the smoothed absolute actual current value.
Displays the smoothed actual value of the modulation depth.
Displays the field-generating current actual value (Id_act).
Displays the smoothed torque-generating actual current.
Displays the smoothed torque actual value.
Displays the instantaneous active power. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed with p0045 [2] = Electric power
Displays the smoothed actual value of the active power.

Displays the reference quantity for power ratings. All power ratings specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity in this parameter corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex or 4000 0000 hex.

descriere_scurta: Motor temperature model, stator winding temperature
descriere: Displays the stator winding temperature of the motor temperature model.
Displays the motor utilization from the thermal I2t motor model.
Displays the actual temperature in the motor.

descriere_scurta: Power unit alarm with I2t overload
descriere: Sets the alarm threshold for the I2t power unit overload. Drive: If this threshold is exceeded, an overload alarm is generated and the system responds as parameterized in p0290. Infeed: When the threshold value is exceeded, only an overload alarm is output.
Displays the electrical energy used since the last reset.

Sets the smoothing time constant for the following display values: SERVO: r0078[1], r0079[1], r0081 (calculated from the quantities smoothed with p0045), r0082[1]. VECTOR: r0063[1], r0068[1], r0080[1], r0082[1].

descriere_scurta: Cooling system, feedback signals, signal source
descriere: Sets the signal sources for the feedback signals from the cooling system. Index: [0] = Cooling system powered up [1] = Cooling system ready to be powered up [2] = Cooling system, no alarm present [3] = Cooling system, no fault present [4] = Cooling system, no leaked liquid [5] = Cooling system, liquid flow OK [6] = Cooling system, conductivity < fault threshold [7] = Cooling system, conductivity < alarm threshold
Displays the command data set (CDS) selected via the binector input.
Displays the actual speed values sensed by the encoders (unsmoothed).
Displays the actual speed setpoint after the setpoint filters.
Displays the slip frequency for induction motors (ASM).
Displays the Motor Module output frequency.
Displays the maximum output current of the Motor Module.
Displays the measured actual value of the DC link voltage.
Displays the maximum output voltage.
Displays the actual modulation depth.

Displays the torque-generating current actual value (Iq_act).
Displays the torque setpoint at the output of the speed controller (before clock cycle interpolation).
Displays the smoothed torque utilization as a percentage. The torque utilization is obtained from the required smoothed torque in reference to the torque limit, scaled using p2196.
Displays the flux setpoint.
Sets the smoothing time for the flux actual value.
Displays the actual active power factor.
Displays the setpoint for the DC link voltage.
